answer: SELECT SUM(s.DOCType='Unified School District')*1.0/SUM(s.DOCType='Elementary School District') FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode=f.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Orange'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode=f.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Los Angeles' AND s.Charter=0 AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`*100.0/f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT s.School, f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`*100.0/f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Los Angeles' AND s.GSserved='K-9'

SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`*100.0/f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, f.`District Code` FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.AdmFName1='Alusine' OR s.AdmFName2='Alusine' OR s.AdmFName3='Alusine'

SELECT s.NCESSchool FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.CDSCode IN ('01751010130583','01612910137588','01611760134270') AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`=(SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm f2 WHERE f2.CDSCode IN ('01751010130583','01612910137588','01611760134270'))

SELECT s.School, s.MailStreet FROM schools s JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds=s.CDSCode WHERE sa.rtype='S' AND s.DOCType='State Board of Education' AND sa.AvgScrRead=(SELECT MAX(sa2.AvgScrRead) FROM schools s2 JOIN satscores sa2 ON sa2.cds=s2.CDSCode WHERE sa2.rtype='S' AND s2.DOCType='State Board of Education')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools s JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds=s.CDSCode WHERE sa.rtype='S' AND s.MailCity='San Francisco' AND s.DOCType IN ('Unified School District','High School District','Elementary School District','County Office of Education (COE)') AND sa.AvgScrRead+sa.AvgScrMath+sa.AvgScrWrite>=1500
SELECT School, EILName FROM schools WHERE CDSCode='01612590136051'

SELECT COUNT(*)/12.0 FROM schools WHERE County='San Diego' AND OpenDate>='1980-01-01' AND OpenDate<'1981-01-01' AND DOCType IN ('Unified School District','Elementary School District','High School District')

SELECT f.`County Name`, COUNT(*) AS n FROM frpm f JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds=f.CDSCode WHERE sa.rtype='S' AND f.`Academic Year`='2014-2015' AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`*1.0/f.`Enrollment (K-12)`>0.1 AND sa.NumGE1500>=1 GROUP BY f.`County Name` ORDER BY n DESC, f.`County Name`
